description: Open Data Nepal is a data repository run by Open Knowledge Nepal. The portal collects public data sets for Nepal, including roads, hydropower, health facilities, schools, earthquake damage and flood and landslide data, with links to the sources. Coverage: Nepal. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, shp, geojson; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. It can support infrastructure and hazard exposure studies of Nepal. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
